rules: A type is held when a pub fn returns it, with one Result layer removed, or a pub field has it.
A type is accepted when it is a pub fn parameter.
Each type counts once per crate, and types rank by how many crates use them.
From the rust list, keeps the top 8 held types of each kind, not kept already, that show up in at least 3 crates.
From the aws list, keeps the top 3 held types of each kind, not kept already, that show up in at least 2 crates.
From the crypto list, keeps the top 1 held types of each kind, not kept already, that show up in at least 3 crates.
The Rust list's top 2 types of a kind need only 2 crates.

A third-party type is bytes, text, a path or a reader when its crate implements AsRef, Deref, Borrow, Read or AsyncRead for it with that target. It is a stream when it is made From bytes but has no such impl.
Of the fixed-size byte arrays, only the most common length is kept.
Skips generic types, &mut types, and arrays whose length is a name.

stream.why: aws-smithy-types implements From<Bytes> for ByteStream, but nothing that lends its bytes, so it is a stream.
aws-smithy-types implements From<&[u8]> for SdkBody, but nothing that lends its bytes, so it is a stream.

text.why: zeroize implements Deref for Zeroizing, so a Zeroizing reads as the value inside it.

AppName.doc: App name that can be configured with an AWS SDK client to become part of the user agent string.

Blob.doc: Binary Blob Type. Blobs represent protocol-agnostic binary content.

ByteStream.doc: Stream of binary data. `ByteStream` wraps a stream of binary data for ease of use.

Bytes.doc: A cheaply cloneable and sliceable chunk of contiguous memory.
A 128-bit (16 byte) buffer containing the UUID.

SdkBody.doc: SdkBody type. This is the Body used for dispatching all HTTP Requests. For handling responses, the type of the body will be controlled by the HTTP stack.

SigningRegionSet.doc: Generally, user code will not need to interact with `SigningRegionSet`. See `Region`.

Zeroizing.doc: `Zeroizing` is a wrapper for any `Z: Zeroize` type which implements a `Drop` handler which zeroizes dropped values.
